notes.title: Dev Blog #11: Demo Release Date Confirmed!
notes.notes:
It’s official—Void Future’s first public demo is launching on April 22nd! 🗓️

After careful testing, bug fixing, and waiting for platform approval, everything is now ready. No more delays, no more uncertainty. The build is solid, the systems are stable, and we’re confident this version reflects what we’ve been working toward.

This will be the first demo for Void Future, and we’re incredibly excited to finally get it into your hands. It covers the opening portion of the game, introducing the world, the core gameplay, and the tone we’re building.

That said—this is just the beginning. Depending on the feedback we receive from this first release, we plan to create a second, expanded demo down the line. Your impressions, experiences, and suggestions will help us shape what comes next.

Thanks again for sticking with us through this journey. April 22 is just around the corner, and we can’t wait to see what you think.

💾 Wishlist on Steam | 🧠 Follow us for updates | 🖥️ Demo drops soon!

notes.title: Dev Blog #10: Demo Delay Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We have a quick update regarding the release of the Void Future demo. While we were originally aiming to release it this week, we’ve decided to push it back just a bit longer.

The reason? Twofold:

1. We discovered a few unexpected bugs during final testing that we feel absolutely need to be addressed before launch. The demo needs to reflect the experience we’ve worked so hard to create, and rushing it out with known issues just wouldn’t be fair to you—or to the game.

2. We’re currently waiting for final approval from Steam. The demo is submitted and everything is in motion, but as with all platforms, there’s a review process that takes a bit of time.

We know delays are never fun, and we appreciate your patience more than ever. The good news? The demo is done. We’re polishing, waiting, and preparing to make sure your first dive into the world of Void Future is as smooth and impactful as possible.

Thanks for sticking with us—we’re almost there!
